title: regexpPattern
summary: Create a regular expression string pattern.

gpu_support.notes: Regular-expression text is host-only; numeric resident handles reject without implicit text conversion or provider access.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: pat = regexpPattern(expr) - Create a regular expression string pattern.
behaviors: Create a regular expression string pattern.
Regular expression pattern objects are accepted by matches, contains, startsWith, endsWith, erase, replace, and boundary helpers.
Integer and other numeric inputs have no semantic role and reject without conversion; this includes resident numeric handles.
examples: regexpPattern("A\d+") creates a regular-expression pattern object.
